scenes.title: The Road to Raven’s Hold
scenes.rationale: The user grouped departure, tracking, route choice, and the first camp’s map discussion into one opening journey-and-planning scene.

scenes.title: Shani’s Warning
scenes.rationale: The approach, spyglass and concealment preparations, greeting, healing, and warnings belong to one encounter with the same herders. The preceding travel and subsequent camp provide its lead-in and close.

scenes.title: Gnolls in the Night
scenes.rationale: All three beats are tactical phases of one uninterrupted camp ambush. Keep the victory, body search, and immediate aftermath with the fight.

scenes.title: Vulture News and Sulfurous Winds
scenes.rationale: After the ambush, the vulture inquiry and final approach concern assessing what awaits at Raven’s Hold. End with the ominous camp before the new centaur encounter.

scenes.title: Tharandros and the Poisoned Land
scenes.rationale: The warning about Delwath’s shadow, discussion of planar tethers, and negotiation over carrying a message are one continuous conversation with Tharandros and his herd.
